$comment: Planned Slopapp apps, in build order. priority 1-2 = the owner's favourite Setapp apps (ranked by real usage), 3 = later. 'icon' is a Lucide icon name (lucide.dev) for the app icon and website. Once apps/<Name>/app.json exists, that file wins. Regenerate the website catalog with: node scripts/catalog.mjs

skipped.why: A VPN needs servers and an operator. Not something a free app collection should run. Use WireGuard or Tailscale.
An AI photo editor is a product company, not a utility. Revisit much later.
Video downloaders: the owner wants no legal risk (site terms, takedowns), even though the tools themselves are legal.

apps.name: Slopapp
apps.tagline: Every Slopapp app, installed and up to date.
apps.spec: The hub app. Library window laid out like a store (Discover with a featured banner and category rows, Installed, Updates, Favorites, All Apps by category, app pages) plus a menu bar item. Browse and search every app from the release feed, install (sha256 + code signature checked), open, update, update all, uninstall to the Trash. Finds apps installed elsewhere. Background update check at most every 6 hours, no telemetry.

apps.name: Switchboard
apps.tagline: Open every link in the right browser.
apps.spec: Registers as the default browser (and optional file handler). Each opened link is matched against rules (domain, source app, modifier keys) or shows a small picker near the cursor with the installed browsers and apps; number keys choose, Esc cancels. Browser profiles where the browser exposes them. Rules editor in Settings. Must add near-zero latency to opening a link.

apps.name: Clips
apps.tagline: Clipboard history you can search.
apps.spec: Polls NSPasteboard changeCount, stores text/images/files in SwiftData. Global hotkey opens a search panel; Enter pastes. Ignore list for password managers (respect org.nspasteboard.ConcealedType). Pinned items.

apps.name: Dictate
apps.tagline: Talk, and your words appear wherever you're typing.
apps.spec: Hold the Fn key (or a shortcut), speak, release: the words are transcribed on the Mac (Parakeet or Whisper models), optionally tidied (filler words, replacements, on-device Apple Intelligence cleanup) and typed into the focused app. Live preview in a recording ring under the notch, Command Mode to rewrite selected text by voice, audio file transcription, searchable history, per-app cleanup overrides, microphone choice. Models download once, on request. No cloud, no accounts.

apps.name: Squish
apps.tagline: Drop in images and PDFs, get smaller files out.
apps.spec: Drag-and-drop window. Images: resize and re-encode (JPEG/HEIC/PNG/WebP) with ImageIO, strip metadata. PDFs: downsample images with PDFKit/Quartz filters. Show before/after sizes.

apps.name: Snapper
apps.tagline: Screenshots, annotated and shared in seconds.
apps.spec: v1: area, window and full-screen capture on global hotkeys; quick-access thumbnail after each capture (copy, save, drag out, annotate, pin, dismiss); annotation editor (arrow, text, shapes, highlight, blur/pixelate, crop, step counter); pin captures as floating windows; hide desktop icons while capturing. v2: screen recording (MP4/GIF), scrolling capture, OCR via Vision.

apps.name: Convert
apps.tagline: Drop in audio, video or images and convert them.
apps.spec: Drop audio, video or images; pick a preset (MP4/H.264, HEVC, MP3, AAC, WAV, GIF, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP); convert in a queue with progress. AVFoundation + ImageIO only. Merge, trim and extract-audio as stretch goals.

apps.name: Tidy
apps.tagline: Uninstall apps completely and clear out the junk.
apps.spec: v1: app uninstaller that finds leftovers (Application Support, Caches, Preferences, Containers, LaunchAgents, Saved State); user caches, logs and developer junk (Xcode DerivedData, simulators) with sizes; large and old files. Always review-before-delete, always to the Trash. No malware or 'speed up' claims.

apps.name: Dropper
apps.tagline: Pick any color on screen and copy it in the format you need.
apps.spec: Global hotkey opens NSColorSampler. Copies HEX/RGB/HSL/SwiftUI/CSS. Keeps history and saved palettes. Contrast checker between two colors.

apps.name: Ruler
apps.tagline: Measure anything on screen, to the pixel.

apps.name: Iconsmith
apps.tagline: Turn any image into app and folder icons.
apps.spec: Drop an image; get macOS .icns/.iconset, Xcode asset catalogs, iOS sets, favicons. Squircle masks, padding, background fill. Also sets custom icons on files and folders.

apps.name: Specimen
apps.tagline: Browse and compare your fonts.
apps.spec: Grid of installed fonts with live custom preview text and size slider; filter by classification (serif, sans, mono, script, display); favourites and tags; side-by-side compare; activate/deactivate user fonts.

apps.name: Zones
apps.tagline: World clocks and meeting times, in the menu bar.
apps.spec: Menu bar list of cities with local time, offset and day/night cue; a time scrubber to plan across zones; copy a time in several zones; optional second clock in the menu bar.

apps.name: Crate
apps.tagline: Open, preview and make archives.
apps.spec: Open zip/7z/tar/gz/rar (read), preview contents before extracting, extract selected files, create zip/tar.gz with optional password, split large archives. libarchive.

apps.name: Paper
apps.tagline: Read, annotate and edit PDFs.

apps.name: Awake
apps.tagline: Keep your Mac awake, from the menu bar.
apps.spec: Menu bar toggle that holds an IOPMAssertion. Durations: 15m, 1h, 2h, 4h, until turned off. Option to keep the display on or just the system. Icon shows state. Launch at login.

apps.name: Focus
apps.tagline: A calm focus timer that lives in your menu bar.
apps.spec: Pomodoro-style timer: work/break lengths, remaining time in the menu bar, notification at the end, daily count of sessions. Optional: turn on a macOS Focus mode via Shortcuts.

apps.name: Tally
apps.tagline: A notepad that does the math as you type.
apps.spec: Each line is an expression; results align on the right. Variables, percentages, units (length, mass, data, time), currency with a cached rate file, previous-line references. Parser is a pure Swift library with heavy unit tests.

apps.name: Devkit
apps.tagline: Offline developer tools: JSON, Base64, JWT, hashes and more.
apps.spec: Sidebar of tools: JSON format/validate, Base64, URL encode, JWT decode, UUID/ULID, hashes, timestamps, regex tester, color convert, diff. Optional clipboard auto-detect picks the right tool. All logic in a pure, tested core.

apps.name: Commit
apps.tagline: A calm Git client.

apps.name: Gauge
apps.tagline: CPU, memory, network and battery in your menu bar.
apps.spec: Menu bar items for CPU, memory, network, disk, battery. Dropdown with sparkline history and top processes. Sampling via host_statistics64, sysctl, IOKit. Low CPU overhead is a requirement.

apps.name: Tuck
apps.tagline: Tuck menu bar icons out of sight.
apps.spec: Hide and reorder menu bar items; a hidden section revealed by click or hotkey; show items when they update. Uses the Accessibility API and the system's menu bar item ordering; check what macOS 26+ already offers natively before building.

apps.name: Triggers
apps.tagline: Your own gestures, shortcuts and actions.
apps.spec: Trackpad gestures, mouse buttons and keyboard shortcuts, per app, mapped to actions (keys, menu items, window moves, open URL, run shortcut). CGEventTap and Accessibility. Scope v1 tightly; the original is enormous.

apps.name: Shorthand
apps.tagline: Type a few letters, get the whole thing.
apps.spec: Text snippets that expand as you type an abbreviation, with placeholders (date, clipboard, cursor position) and a searchable snippet library. CGEventTap + Accessibility; secure input fields are never read.

apps.name: Dual
apps.tagline: A two-pane file manager with remote servers.

apps.name: Snip
apps.tagline: Copy text from anything on your screen.
apps.spec: Global hotkey, drag a region, ScreenCaptureKit grabs it, Vision recognizes text, result goes to the clipboard. Also reads QR codes and barcodes. Language picker.

apps.name: Tiles
apps.tagline: Snap windows into place with the keyboard.
apps.spec: Keyboard shortcuts for halves, thirds, quarters, maximize, center, next display. Uses AXUIElement; first-run screen walks through the Accessibility permission. Layout math in a pure, tested core.

apps.name: Switches
apps.tagline: One menu for dark mode, hidden desktop icons and more.

apps.name: Quit
apps.tagline: Quit every app at once, except the ones you keep.

apps.name: Shelf
apps.tagline: A place to park files while you drag.

apps.name: Margin
apps.tagline: Quick notes tucked into the edge of your screen.

apps.name: Hours
apps.tagline: See where your time went, automatically and privately.

apps.name: Twins
apps.tagline: Find and remove duplicate files.

apps.name: Glance
apps.tagline: Your calendar and world clocks, one click away.

apps.name: Seek
apps.tagline: Find files by name, kind, size and date.
